terminal_semantics.FULL_PREPROD: Capability is materially present in current main at the declared governed PREPROD scope; this does not authorize PROD.
terminal_semantics.TERMINAL_REFERENCE_ONLY: Useful external or architectural reference is catalogued but importing it would duplicate current capability or is not justified.
terminal_semantics.TERMINAL_HOLD: Candidate remains deliberately inactive because provenance or exact upstream identity is insufficient; HOLD is terminal for this reconciliation until evidence changes.

items.name: FACT-001 · Fábrica de Motores y Skills V0 real
items.reason: Factory and governed request runner already exist in current main; no parallel factory is justified.

items.name: Integración automática de skills · registro + versionado
items.reason: Current skill evolution/autonomy contracts already govern registration, version-aware evolution and safe decisions.

items.name: Análisis de impacto automático de skills
items.reason: Impact/evaluation hooks are already part of the governed skill evolution path.

items.name: OLD vs NEW automático para skills
items.reason: OLD vs NEW and tribunal gates exist and remain fail-closed.

items.name: Shadow / real-world testing
items.reason: Experiment and PREPROD adoption monitoring provide the governed shadow-testing surface without granting production writes.

items.name: Auto-promoción / rollback de skills
items.reason: Promotion/rollback logic is present but remains governed; this reconciliation does not authorize automatic PROD promotion.

items.name: Patrón agent-eval-loop
items.reason: No unique upstream identity/provenance was established. Existing evaluation/experiment capability covers the architectural need; no external import is justified.

items.name: Skill-RSI · referencia OpenClaw
items.reason: Useful reference only: current CEREBRO already has governed RSI/meta-learning overlap, so importing another runtime would duplicate capability.

items.name: Patrón Skill Factory · rooftop-Owl
items.reason: Exact upstream identity/provenance is unresolved and FACT-001 already covers the factory pattern; do not import unknown code.

items.name: Capa QA común obligatoria
items.reason: Common QA, knowledge quality and bounded remediation surfaces exist in current main.

items.name: Tribunal técnico multi-rol
items.reason: Technical tribunal and its OLD-vs-NEW gate are present and fail closed.

items.name: Aprendizaje continuo de cada motor
items.reason: Continuous improvement, scheduling, orchestration and durable learning ledger already exist.

items.name: Shared Agent Runtime fabric
items.reason: Shared runtime, persistence and worker execution fabric exist; do not create one server per engine.

items.name: Cola / scheduler robusto de jobs
items.reason: Durable PREPROD job runtime already implements queued work, leases, checkpoints and worker execution.

items.name: DBOS · candidato de workflows durables
items.reason: Internal durable runtime materially covers the required retry/idempotency/checkpoint/resume semantics at zero additional cost; DBOS remains a catalogued benchmark, not a dependency.

items.name: Retry policy estándar
items.reason: Deterministic exponential retry with bounded jitter/max attempts is present.

items.name: Idempotencia estándar
items.reason: Scoped idempotency keys and deterministic learning replay protection are present.

items.name: Resume / restart seguro tras fallo
items.reason: Persistent journal, checkpoints and continuity handoff support governed resume/restart.

items.name: Watchdog / self-heal genérico
items.reason: Expired leases are repaired through bounded retry/dead-letter behavior and bounded recovery supervision.

items.name: API externa con Model Router
items.reason: Execution Model Router already governs deterministic/local/registered/free routes before paid/external paths and blocks unauthorized execution.

items.name: Free/local providers catalog
items.reason: Router policy explicitly defines local/free resource classes and zero-cost priority. Live provider eligibility is evaluated per registered resource; this is not a claim that every provider is connected.

items.name: Fallback chain de modelos
items.reason: Router ranks zero-cost eligible resources and emits a fallback chain; paid fallback is never automatic.

items.name: Budget / FinOps por tarea
items.reason: Per-task routing enforces a zero-cost hard cap and MONEY_LIMIT for paid routes; observability/FinOps runtime records governed economics.

items.name: Provenance / auditoría de respuesta y decisión
items.reason: Audit/observability ledgers and RSI observability adapter provide provenance/accountability surfaces without adding a new external dependency.
